text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival. 
Leaving behind 
the bustling academy grounds, I made my 
way to—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come, come! Well met, traveler! 
—Steel your resolve and take up that blade 
right there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A full-scale interactive event taking 
place on the mountain behind the academy. 
With its theme of "Experiencing Life as a 
Warlord's Retainer," 
it was already creating quite a buzz on 
social media.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You have come as well, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Of course. It's your big attraction, 
Phalaeno.

Of course. It's your big attraction, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye, enjoy it to your heart's content! 
For this festival exists solely thanks to 
Phalaeno-dono!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I ended up thoroughly swept along. 
—And yet, truth be told, it is rather 
delightful.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, since you came all this way, 
you should savor it to your heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Are both of ye ready? 
Then hear ye! From this moment forth— 
Phalaeno-dono shall be thy "Lord"!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Become a worthy vassal, 
and revel in this realm to the very 
fulleeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then, my faithful vassal. 
Let us commence our training at once.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We live in the Warring States. 
Gain strength, or be devoured.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First, musket practice. 
Take aim at that target and fire a test 
shot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where she pointed, stuffed animals were 
lined 
up to be shot with a cork gun. 
---In other words, it was a festival 
shooting gallery.

text_block_list.name: Cork Gun Firing Sound
text_block_list.text: *Pop!*

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Your stance shifted.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No matter. Grazing it proves your 
potential. 
However, your body is rather stiff.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. Come here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Rest your weight against me... Yes, like 
that. 
Tuck in your elbows, steady your aim---

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......Fiiire!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Practice is essential. 
---Yet, your instincts are sound.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, raise your weapon once more. 
I shall train you thoroughly until our 
time is up.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Attendant
text_block_list.text:
My Liege, please review this document 
next! 
And after that---

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. 
...I grow rather weary of this.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, perhaps I shall venture out for an 
excursion.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Attendant
text_block_list.text:
What?! Y-You cannot! 
The townsfolk will be thrown into an 
uproar!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis's Attendant
text_block_list.text:
If you go missing on me, 
I will search high and low until my eyes 
bleed!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. So long as no one recognizes me, 
it matters not. 
...You there, attend to me.
choice_data_list: Huh?! Y-Yes, at once, My Liege!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on behalf of my lord on her 
"incognito" excursion, 
I made the rounds of the stalls just as 
ordered---
choice_data_list: All that's left is...---Oh, candy apples!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ---Ah, you have returned.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I grew tired of waiting. 
Come, let us satisfy our appetites.
choice_data_list: Were you up in that tree all this time...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh.---When I was young, I would often 
climb the castle's 
solitary pine, leap over the ramparts, and 
sneak away.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: There is no tree I cannot climb.
choice_data_list:
(Is that part of the roleplay, or a true 
story...?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ---Hear me, my loyal retainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The hour has come to march forth. 
...To claim dominion over all the realm.
choice_data_list: To conquer the realm, My Liege?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In other words--- 
it is time to settle things with that one. 
With that troublesome enemy general...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet with you at my side, defeat is 
impossible. 
Of that, I am certain.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
What say you? ...Are you prepared to 
follow me?
choice_data_list:
I shall follow you wherever you go, My 
Liege!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Without hesitation.---Splendid!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then forward! To battle!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...You needn't say a word! 
The two of you came to strike me down, 
didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Lady No Reason. 
Are you prepared?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Heh-heh-heh! 
Nyahahahaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Did you truly think I would just roll 
over?! 
Behold! My legions lying in ambush!

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Phalaenopsis! Steel yourself!" 
"We will stop you here, without fail!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Gah, such numbers! To think there were 
this many...! 
Curse you, you laid a trap!!
choice_data_list: My Liege, we haven't lost yet!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: !! ...Heh, I know.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My resolve was forged long ago. 
Then there is nothing left but to push 
through!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Are you saying the two of you 
intend to break through this vast army all 
by yourselves?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed we shall! So long as this one is at 
my side!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Guh, what fearsome spirit...! 
At this rate, we'll be done fooor...!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Or so I let you think! Now's our chance! 
Archers! Loose your arrows upon that 
retainer over there~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As if I'd let you! 
Quick, get behind me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Aha, you left an opening~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! 
That scene was a contest of wits—the 
outcome wasn't set in stone!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And so, this round goes to me~. 
Wouldn't you say, Lady Phalaeno?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Making such an impression of 
having countless ambushes right from the 
get-go 
naturally made me believe you had archers 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet not a single arrow flew. 
You completely outplayed me, Lady No 
Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Gwahaha, you fell right into my trap~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Well, in this particular case, 
I was certain that would make you leave an 
opening.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...You jest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Phalaenopsis moved to close in on 
No Reason— 
the other samurai charged straight for her 
back!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant, I had sprinted straight 
forward 
to protect my "lord," Phalaenopsis...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~! I've never seen anyone pull 
a stunt like that at the very end before~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! 
To think you'd throw yourself in as a 
shield!
choice_data_list:
I guess I was just completely swept up in 
the moment...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Were you really that immersed in your 
role? 
Or could it beee...?
choice_data_list: It was pretty weird, wasn't it?
It looked pretty silly, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. 
It was a truly admirable display of 
loyalty.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And all the more reason I must strive to 
be 
a lord worthy of it. —That is how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Now, come here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You pushed yourself too hard. 
You've got a scratch on your cheek.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Come here so I can tend to it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It might sting a little, but bear 
with it, alright?
